label: sr_fixed_dimensions
title: Individual dimensions of the selected fixed-hotel S program

cells: Inventory relative to the selling window
Bounded difference between average remaining inventory fraction and the remaining fraction of the episode.
Bounded difference between the type-specific display-price proxy and the inventory-weighted mean hotel price.
Bounded average exposure-support weight across all 30 hotels.
Demand pressure carried by available stock
Support-adjusted demand pressure averaged using current inventory fractions.
Price level of the remaining catalog
Bounded inventory-weighted mean price when a hotel is available; zero otherwise.
Bounded mean of support-adjusted demand pressure over hotels with positive inventory.
Bounded mean of the price deviation from the inventory-weighted mean multiplied by support-adjusted demand pressure among available hotels.
Bounded mean price-proximity score among currently available hotels.
Relative price adjusted for demand pressure
Relative price minus one quarter of support-adjusted demand pressure, followed by a bounded transformation.
Current matching adjusted for the remaining window
Price-proximity score minus remaining-window-weighted demand pressure, followed by a bounded transformation.
Price position as the window closes
Relative price weighted by elapsed progress, plus one quarter of the proximity score, followed by a bounded transformation.
